signals.name: Engine oil temperature, transmission controller
signals.description: [Polling: Unclassified; research override] Second response byte minus 60 °C. Agrees within a few degrees of the DME oil temperature in sampled sessions; one low outlier remains unexplained.

signals.name: Transmission reported gear or state
signals.description: [Polling: Unclassified; research override] Second response byte varies with driving. Values 1–8 observed as likely gears; 0x0A has been observed and its meaning is unverified.

signals.name: Accumulated time in Drive mode
signals.description: [Polling: Cumulative history] Big-endian 32-bit seconds counter, displayed in hours. Paired samples advance at one raw count per elapsed second while Drive mode is active.

signals.name: Accumulated time in Sport mode
signals.description: [Polling: Cumulative history] Research-only counter converted with the seconds-to-hours scale inferred from the Drive counter. Sport/Manual mode attribution has not been confirmed by a controlled mode-change recording.

signals.name: Accumulated time in Manual mode
signals.description: [Polling: Cumulative history] Research-only counter converted with the seconds-to-hours scale inferred from the Drive counter. Sport/Manual mode attribution has not been confirmed by a controlled mode-change recording.
